subject: MAP draft & target close alignment (OlivePay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@olivepay.com>, Dan Morris <dan.morris@olivepay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & target close alignment (OlivePay)

Hi Emma / Dan —

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we can lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and confirm target close / procurement timelines. I attached a first-draft MAP (olivepay_map_draft_v1.xlsx).

Recap (from today's call)
- Goal: Pilot Redwood Dedicated for fraud-prevention model in production (low-latency generation + embeddings for reranking).
- Primary success metrics: 99th %-tile latency < 120ms, cost target <$0.0008/token for bulk inference, integration by Q3.
- Stakeholders: Emma (Product), Dan (Procurement), Legal (OlivePay), Camila (SE), Aditya (Ops).

Proposed MAP (high level) — target close: 2026-07-31
- Milestone 1 (By 2026-07-10): Finalize technical scope & integration plan — Owner: Camila (Redwood) / Emma (OlivePay)
- Milestone 2 (By 2026-07-15): Pricing confirmation & commercial terms review — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Dan (OlivePay)
- Milestone 3 (By 2026-07-20): Legal review / contract redlines submitted — Owner: OlivePay Legal / Marissa (Redwood) loop-in Aditya as needed
- Milestone 4 (By 2026-07-28): Procurement approval & signature window — Owner: Dan (OlivePay)
- Milestone 5 (By 2026-07-31): Go/no-go + kickoff for Dedicated provisioning — Owner: Emma (OlivePay) / Redwood delivery team

Dependencies / blockers
- SOC 2 evidence and any compliance attestation (OlivePay requires SOC2/SOC3) — Redwood can provide attestations and a point of contact (Aditya).
- Contract redlines need to be returned to us by 2026-07-20 to meet the 7/31 close window.
- Pricing approval internally at OlivePay (we need Dan's sign-off week of 7/12).

Ask
1) Please review the attached MAP draft and confirm owners & dates (or suggest adjustments).
2) Confirm whether procurement can target signature by 2026-07-28 (we need sign by then to complete provisioning for a 7/31 close).
3) If that looks tight, propose the latest acceptable signature date so we can shift timeline proactively.

Thanks — I'll follow up in two days if I haven't heard back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (555) 214-9876

Attachment: olivepay_map_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@olivepay.com>

Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & target close alignment (OlivePay)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and appreciate the MAP draft. Quick responses from our side: 

- Pricing: We need a formal pricing proposal for the Dedicated configuration (X GPUs, Y throughput) by 2026-07-15 for our finance review. Can you confirm pricing details / a line item sheet?
- Compliance / Procurement: Our procurement team needs SOC2 evidence + the procurement checklist completed. I'm attaching our internal checklist for reference (olivepay_procurement_checklist.pdf).
- Legal timeline: if Legal receives contract redlines after 2026-07-20, we risk pushing the signature beyond July end — our internal windows are tight due to Q3 budget timing.

Two items to flag:
1) If procurement cannot commit to sign by 7/28, we will likely need to move the target close to the first week of August (propose 2026-08-05) to avoid a rushed rollout.
2) We'd like a 30-minute technical sync with Camila next week to confirm the integration approach and any provisioning lead times. Available slots: Tue 7/7 or Wed 7/8 AM Pacific.

I'll bring Dan and one of our legal folks to the technical sync if needed.

Thanks,
Emma
Product Lead, OlivePay
emma.liu@olivepay.com
(415) 555-0199

Thanks, Emma — happy to take the technical sync. A few clarifications that affect milestones / dependencies: 

Technical dependencies & impact on MAP
- SOC2/SOC3: Redwood can provide SOC2 Type II report and SOC3 summary. I (Camila) will attach the attestation link & contact Aditya for any infra-level questions. Having those docs to Legal by 7/10 will materially accelerate their review.
- Provisioning lead time: Dedicated pool provisioning typically requires 3 business days from signature + model onboarding time (we should plan a 1-week internal buffer).
- Integration work: Minor changes to how you stream inference (tokenization config) — we estimate 2 sprints to validate (with PO backing).

Suggested MAP adjustments if procurement timeline slips
- If procurement can only start legal review after 7/20, move target close to 2026-08-05 and adjust provisioning kickoff to 2026-08-06.

Next steps
1) I'll upload the SOC2 attestation link to the MAP and send to Emma/Legal by 7/08.
2) Camila/Marissa to run a 30-min tech sync (Tue 7/7 at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm).
3) Marissa: pricing line items to Dan by 7/15 (per Emma's ask).

Thanks — happy to jump on the call and unblock anything technical.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Thanks team — great alignment so far. Quick update and proposal to lock dates so everyone can calendar against them.

Summary of agreed items so far:
- Tech sync: Tue 7/7 at 10:00 AM PT with Camila (confirmed) — Camila will share SOC attestation by 7/08.
- Pricing: Marissa to deliver line-item pricing by 7/15.
- Legal: OlivePay to provide redlines by 7/20 if we are to keep 7/31 close.

To be explicit on the signature window: we need procurement signature by 2026-07-28 to meet the 2026-07-31 target close (this gives delivery 3 business days to provision and 1 week for onboarding buffer). If OlivePay cannot guarantee redlines to Legal by 7/20 or sign by 7/28, Camila's proposed contingency is appropriate: move target close to 2026-08-05.

Action items (updated MAP v2 attached)
- Marissa: send formal pricing line items to Dan by 2026-07-15 (ACTION: Marissa)
- Emma: confirm procurement can target signature by 2026-07-28 or confirm the latest acceptable signature date by 2026-07-09 (ACTION: Emma)
- Camila: upload SOC2 attestation link and technical onboarding checklist by 2026-07-08 (ACTION: Camila)
- Aditya / Rishi: standing by to support legal redlines and SOC questions (ACTION: Aditya, Rishi)

If you confirm procurement can sign by 7/28, we'll keep the 7/31 close and proceed. If not, we'll shift the MAP to a 2026-08-05 target close and update the provisioning schedule accordingly. Please reply to confirm owners and dates so we can lock the MAP and update the HubSpot deal (link below).
